basic_info.description: Situated on a quiet block of San Jose Avenue, this ground floor residence boasts a spacious floor plan with a large kitchen including a fully integrated, cabinet-faced refrigerator, dishwasher, quartz countertops and under cabinet lighting. One luxurious bathroom is fit for a spa with designer tile finishes, quartz vanity top with undermounted sink, widespread faucet and walk-in shower with glass partition and hand-shower.  Other features include underfloor heating and private entrance and terrace!
